Clinical cases with sparse, irregular visits (simulated)

Source: R/data.R
clinical_cases.Rd

Sixty children seen in a paediatric clinic at irregular intervals, with referral group and gestational age, for Book 1 Part II and broken-stick examples. Generated by wgh_simulate_clinical_cases(60, seed = 2024).

Usage

clinical_cases

Format

A data frame with pid, sex, group, gestational_age, age, age_corrected, height, weight, bmi, haz, waz, baz.

Examples

head(clinical_cases)
#>    pid    sex                  group gestational_age    age age_corrected
#> 1 K001 Female Short stature referral              38 10.866        10.866
#> 2 K001 Female Short stature referral              38 11.088        11.088
#> 3 K001 Female Short stature referral              38 11.669        11.669
#> 4 K001 Female Short stature referral              38 11.864        11.864
#> 5 K001 Female Short stature referral              38 12.012        12.012
#> 6 K002   Male         Obesity clinic              38  4.439         4.439
#>   height weight   bmi    haz   waz    baz
#> 1  146.7   30.7 14.27  0.388    NA -1.665
#> 2  147.1   31.4 14.51  0.231    NA -1.572
#> 3  147.4   32.6 15.00 -0.270    NA -1.455
#> 4  148.4   33.5 15.21 -0.297    NA -1.394
#> 5  148.8   32.5 14.68 -0.366    NA -1.800
#> 6  100.8   20.2 19.88 -1.245 1.206  2.946
table(clinical_cases$group)
#> 
#>         Obesity clinic      Preterm follow-up      Routine follow-up 
#>                     96                     44                    112 
#> Short stature referral 
#>                     84
